name: Citizenship by Marriage

qualifying_event.description: Marriage to, and joint legal residence with, a Lithuanian citizen for the required period qualifies the foreign spouse for citizenship, under Article 7's exceptions to the general dual-citizenship prohibition.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; proof of joint legal residence with citizen spouse for the required period.

requirements.blocker_text: 7 years of marriage to, and joint legal residence with, a Lithuanian citizen spouse.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years of marriage and joint residence with the citizen spouse.

requirements.blocker_text: Must pass the same A2-level Lithuanian language examination required for standard naturalisation.
Must pass the same Constitution examination (20 questions, at least 14 correct) required for standard naturalisation.

requirement_groups.name: Reduced 5-year route -- deportee/political-prisoner spouse or widowed after 1 year

requirements.blocker_text: A reduced 5-year joint-residence requirement applies where the citizen spouse (or their child) was deported or a political prisoner, or where the citizen spouse died after at least 1 year of marriage. Language and Constitution exam conditions still apply.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of marriage and joint residence, meeting the deportee/political-prisoner or widowed-after-1-year condition.

evidence_required.document: Proof of joint legal residence with citizen spouse for the required period

sources.title: European Commission -- 'Pathways to citizenship for third-country nationals in Lithuania': marriage-based route, 7-year standard joint-residence requirement, reduced 5-year tracks for deportee/political-prisoner spouse or widowhood after 1 year of marriage, same language/Constitution exam conditions as standard naturalisation, dual citizenship permitted under Article 7 of the Law on Citizenship for this category
